role: Time control. Manages the tick loop. Controls execution rhythm of all God Systems. The heartbeat.
tick_behavior: Self-referential — generates its own ticks. 900ms real mode. Stepped on manual command. Frozen on pause. Replay mode scrubs tickHistory ring buffer (60 ticks).

modes.stepped: Manual tick via command. Debug mode.
modes.replay: Scrub tickHistory. Left/right TRON nav moves tick cursor.

constraints: tickHistory max 60 frames — ring buffer, oldest overwritten
Mode changes must go through TRON UI or GOVERNOR intent
